spans.s: श्वोभूतिवृत्ति a grammatical work of the type of a gloss on the Sutras of Panini written by an ancient grammarian श्वोभूति mentioned in the Mahabhasya; cf. स्तोष्याम्यहं पादिकमौदवाहिं ततः श्वेाभूत शातनीं पातनीं च M. Bh. on
. Possibly the grammarian श्वोभूति is referred to in the word श्वोभूत in the verse. ष
